record.content: ReserveAmerica facility EB/110458 names Trails End, Fern Dell, and Girls Camp. All group camps close seasonally November 1 through May 15, subject to change. Reservations are limited to one per party/date, seven nights per month and 30 nights per year. Trails End receives five parking passes; Fern Dell and Girls Camp receive ten each, with no extras. Trails End and Fern Dell use Wayside Overflow; Girls Camp uses Skyline Gate. Driving into sites is prohibited and wagons are recommended.
